## Rule

Each colored cell draws an L-shaped trail: it extends right along its row to the right edge of the grid, then turns and extends down from that corner cell to the bottom edge. The cell itself is included. Background is black (0).

Verified on all 3 train examples (2026-06-06):
- ex0: color 2 @(1,2) → fills row 1 cols 2–5 AND col 5 rows 2–3 (bottom edge) ✓
- ex1: color 6 @(1,1) → fills row 1 cols 1–2 AND col 2 rows 2–2 ✓
- ex2: color 8 @(1,1) → fills row 1 to right edge AND that edge column down to bottom ✓

If multiple colored cells exist, each independently draws its own L-trail (colors may overlap — last writer wins, or they don't overlap in practice).
